content:
**Track B (SDD harness port) contract inventory — measured surface for B0-B3**

## What
Read-only measurement of the real surface Track B (PLAN-adapters-v3 §3) must abstract, ahead of B0-B3 sequencing decision. brain repo, branch feat/issue-239-a3.

## Why
Human+reviewer needs a measured (not assumed) inventory before committing to B0 (sdd-layout.md spec), B1 (sdd-layout.mjs accessor), B2 (plain backend), B3 (openspec-fission adapter).

## 1. Harness verb set (brain/core/methodology/harness-contract.md:23-46)
Required: brain:env:init, brain:day:start, brain:session:start, brain:ticket:start -- <id>, brain:project:feature -- --issue <id> (creates openspec/changes/issue-<id>-<slug>/ with proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md, spec.md per the doc), brain:repo:check, brain:change:verify, memory:share, memory:pull, memory:index.
Optional: /sdd-explore, /sdd-continue, /sdd-apply, /sdd-archive, /retomar, /issue-create, /mr-create.
Artifact contract (harness-contract.md:50-57): exactly proposal.md, spec.md, design.md, tasks.md under openspec/changes/issue-<iid>-<slug>/.

## 2. MAJOR SURPRISE — the harness backend abstraction is far narrower than the contract table implies
brain/scripts/harness/cli.mjs:52 — `export const VALID_OPS = ['init'];` — the ONLY op the SDD_HARNESS-swappable dispatcher supports today.
brain/scripts/harness/backends/gentle-ai.mjs exports exactly two things: `_toEngramProject()` (line 74) and `init()` (line 221) — nothing else. `init()` only does: check gentle-ai binary present → run doctor → install if unhealthy+TTY → refresh skill registry → check engram SDD context (sdd-init/<project>) → check brain/project/decisions/ ADR gap. Zero artifact scaffolding, zero verify logic.
brain/scripts/new-change.mjs:1-4 (the actual `brain:project:feature` scaffolder) explicitly says in its header comment: "Scaffolder de changes SDD en formato OpenSpec — harness-neutral. No depende de ningún harness (gentle-ai u otro)." It is NOT routed through harness/cli.mjs at all — it's a single hardcoded implementation, always active regardless of SDD_HARNESS.
Same for brain/scripts/verify-change.mjs (`brain:change:verify`) — it's a harness-neutral diff-scope validator (matches touched paths against a MATRIX, runs backend/frontend/scripts build+lint+test), has NOTHING to do with openspec artifact shape at all. It does not belong to the B1 "layout consumer" list the PLAN names — misclassified in PLAN-adapters-v3.md:203-204.
brain/scripts/brain-next.mjs (the `brain:next` state-machine) also does NOT reference openspec/changes/** anywhere — it only reasons about git branch name, open PRs, `.memory/` git status, and repo:check exit code. Also misclassified as a "layout reader" in the PLAN.

Implication for sequencing: today "the harness" (SDD_HARNESS-swappable piece) = ecosystem init/doctor/install only. The artifact-producing/consuming engine (scaffold in new-change.mjs, phase-order gate, memory checkpoint/resume) is a SINGLE hardcoded harness-neutral implementation, not per-backend. B2's "plain" backend and B3's "openspec-fission" backend, if built only as new files under harness/backends/*.mjs implementing `init()`, would trivially pass and prove nothing — because the real work isn't routed through that dispatcher at all. To make B2/B3 a real proof (per PLAN's own acceptance bar: "zero harness-conditional gate code"), harness/cli.mjs's VALID_OPS must expand (e.g. add 'scaffold'/'verify' ops that new-change.mjs and verify flows are refactored to dispatch through) — this is undocumented added scope not currently reflected in B1's "migrate all readers" framing (PLAN-adapters-v3.md:203-208), and should be raised at CP-B0.

## 3. Layout hard-coding sites (B1 centralization worklist) — file:line + literal

**brain/scripts/check-refs.mjs:96-112** (S-1 structural check, part of brain:repo:check):
- L97: `const changesDir = join(ROOT, 'openspec/changes');`
- L100: `entry.name === 'archive'` (archive dir exclusion)
- L102: `for (const required of ['proposal.md', 'tasks.md'])` — NOTE: only checks proposal.md + tasks.md, NOT spec.md/design.md — inconsistent with the 4-artifact contract.
- L105: `path: \`openspec/changes/${entry.name}/${required}\``

**brain/scripts/session-start.mjs:38-69** (deriveChangeFromBranch, design §1.4):
- L42: doc comment "openspec/changes/* directory names (excluding archive)"
- L56: `branchName.match(/issue-(\d+)/i)` — branch→change token pattern
- L58: `out.token = \`issue-${m[1]}\`;`
- L68: `e.name !== 'archive'`

**brain/scripts/vcs/phase-order-check.mjs** (L4 SDD phase-order gate, DETECTION_JOBS):
- L20: `const CHANGE_DIR_PREFIX = 'openspec/changes/';`
- L95-104: `STATUS_LADDER = ['draft','proposed','spec','designed','tasked','applying','verified','archived']` — a second, independent hardcoded status vocabulary (frontmatter `status:` field ladder) not shared with anything else in the codebase.
- L185: `BASELINE_EXEMPT_DIRS = ['installer-versionado', 'vcs-adapter', 'cli-i18n']` — hardcoded grandfather allowlist for pre-v3 dirs lacking a spec artifact.
- L233: `STATUS_FRONTMATTER_RE = /^status:\s*(\S+)/m` — frontmatter parse pattern.
- L243: `text.match(/^- \[x\]/gim)` — the checked-task pattern (`- [x]`).
- L286-294 (`hasNestedSpec`): checks `${relDir}/specs` + `${specsDir}/${name}/spec.md` — the SECOND spec convention (specs/*/spec.md), tolerated alongside root spec.md — this is the cross-gate inconsistency (see §4).
- L324-330 (`buildChangeDir`): literals `${relDir}/tasks.md`, `${relDir}/proposal.md`, `${relDir}/design.md`, `${relDir}/spec.md`.

**brain/scripts/new-change.mjs** (the `brain:project:feature` scaffolder — harness-neutral, NOT gated by SDD_HARNESS):
- L48: `changeId = title ? \`issue-${issue}-${slugify(title)}\` : \`issue-${issue}\`;` — note: falls back to NO slug when --title omitted, diverging from the canonical `issue-{iid}-{slug}` pattern documented everywhere else.
- L49: `changeDir = join(repoRoot, "openspec", "changes", changeId);`
- L108-110: `writeFileSync(...".../proposal.md"...)`, `".../design.md"`, `".../tasks.md"` — **does NOT write spec.md** (see §4, real gap vs contract).

**brain/scripts/memory/backends/engram.mjs** (featureCheckpoint / featureResume, REQ-S2-1/REQ-E-1):
- L804 and L925: `const changeDir = join(root, "openspec", "changes", resolvedFeature);` (duplicated literal, two functions)
- L805/L926: `const rp = join(changeDir, "resume.md");` — resume.md placement, duplicated.

**brain/scripts/memory/lib/feature-resolution.mjs** (resolveFeature — used by checkpoint/resume):
- L37: `const changesDir = join(root, 'openspec', 'changes');`
- L61: `if (entry === 'archive') return false;`
- L81: `existsSync(join(changesDir, candidate, 'resume.md'))` — resume.md as disambiguation signal when >1 active change dirs exist.

**brain/scripts/vcs/ci-context.mjs, memory/lib/store.mjs, memory/lib/format.mjs, i18n/en.mjs+es.mjs, memory/backends/plainfiles.mjs** — only reference openspec/changes/** in doc comments / i18n strings pointing at spec files (not structural readers of the layout); not part of the B1 worklist.

**brain/scripts/verify-change.mjs and brain/scripts/brain-next.mjs — checked, contain ZERO openspec/changes/** references. PLAN-adapters-v3.md:203-204 names them as B1 consumers but they are not; this should be corrected or the PLAN's claim re-verified against a different revision.**

## 4. Implicit canonical contract as coded today + cross-gate inconsistencies (B0 must resolve)
Implicit contract (inferred from gate code): dir `openspec/changes/issue-<N>[-<slug>]/` (slug optional per new-change.mjs, though the doc/workflow-guide.md always shows it present), containing proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md always, and a spec artifact under EITHER `spec.md` OR `specs/*/spec.md` (phase-order-check.mjs is the only gate that tolerates both — check-refs.mjs and new-change.mjs only know about proposal.md/tasks.md and don't check/produce spec.md at all). Checked-task pattern `- [x]` (case-insensitive, phase-order-check.mjs only). Status frontmatter ladder (8 values, phase-order-check.mjs only — no other gate reads `status:`). `archive` is a reserved/excluded dir name in 3 places (check-refs, session-start, feature-resolution) but no gate defines where archived changes actually live (no `openspec/changes/archive/<iid>/` literal found anywhere — Track E1 in the PLAN says this move doesn't exist yet, confirmed: `brain:change:archive` verb is listed as NOT YET BUILT, depends on B1). `resume.md` lives at `openspec/changes/<feature>/resume.md` (engram.mjs, feature-resolution.mjs) — used as a disambiguation signal for "which change is actively worked," not documented as a required artifact anywhere in harness-contract.md's artifact contract table.

Inconsistencies B0 must decide/resolve:
1. spec.md is documented as required (harness-contract.md, workflow-guide.md) but NOT created by the scaffolder (new-change.mjs) and NOT checked by check-refs.mjs S-1 — only phase-order-check.mjs (a DETECTION_JOBS, non-blocking-by-default gate) even looks for it, and it accepts two shapes.
2. new-change.mjs's changeId omits the slug when --title is absent, producing `issue-<N>/` instead of `issue-<N>-<slug>/` — diverges from the canonical pattern documented in harness-contract.md:50 and workflow-guide.md:73-76.
3. Two independent "is this change done" vocabularies exist with no cross-check: STATUS_LADDER frontmatter values in phase-order-check.mjs vs. checked-task-count in the same file vs. resume.md frontmatter fields (resume-schema.mjs, not yet inventoried in depth here).
4. No gate/script defines the archive destination path as a literal — Track E1 (archive verb) is unbuilt; B1's accessor should decide this path now rather than let E1 invent a second one later.

## 5. Manual/B2 `plain` grounding — what a human does by hand today
docs/workflow-guide.md:46-99, section "B. Manual (no AI — npm verbs in sequence)":
1. `npm run brain:env:init` (one-time)
2. `npm run brain:session:start` (session open)
3. `npm run brain:ticket:start -- <id>` (branch creation)
4. `npm run brain:project:feature -- --issue <id>` — "scaffolds the artifact folder" (comment at workflow-guide.md:69) — but per §3 above, new-change.mjs only actually writes proposal.md/design.md/tasks.md, NOT spec.md, contradicting workflow-guide.md:74 which lists spec.md as one of the 4 files to "edit by hand, in order."
5. Manual edit of all 4 artifacts (guide claims 4, tool delivers 3)
6. Manual code implementation, checking off tasks.md items by hand
7. `npm run brain:repo:check` + `npm test` + `npm run brain:change:verify` (gates)
8. `npm run memory:share` (memory-gate)
9. Commit + PR with "Closes #<id>"
This IS effectively today's de-facto "plain" backend already — it's just not packaged as a `harness/backends/plain.mjs` module; it's the golden-path npm verbs used directly, all harness-neutral already (new-change.mjs, verify-change.mjs, check-refs.mjs are unconditional, not gated by SDD_HARNESS). B2's real incremental work is therefore narrower than "implement the full verb set" — most verbs already work standalone; B2 mainly needs to (a) fix the proposal/design/tasks-only scaffold to also emit spec.md (closing gap #1 above), and (b) decide whether `plain` as a harness/backends module should just be a thin manifest declaring "these already-neutral scripts are my implementation" versus genuinely new code.

## Learned
- The PLAN (docs/inbox/PLAN-adapters-v3.md) misattributes verify-change.mjs and brain-next.mjs as B1 layout-consumers; neither touches openspec/changes/** — verify-change.mjs is a diff-scope-to-build/lint/test matrix, brain-next.mjs is a git/PR state machine. Only 6 real sites exist across 5 files: check-refs.mjs, session-start.mjs, phase-order-check.mjs, new-change.mjs, engram.mjs (x2), feature-resolution.mjs.
- The harness/cli.mjs SDD_HARNESS dispatcher supports only op='init' today (VALID_OPS = ['init']). All actual SDD artifact work (scaffold, verify, phase-order) is hardcoded harness-neutral code untouched by SDD_HARNESS — meaning B2/B3 as scoped in the PLAN ("implements the full harness-contract.md verb set... zero harness-conditional gate code") requires expanding harness/cli.mjs's op surface, which is out-of-frame in the current B1/B2 slice descriptions and should be flagged at CP-B0.
- new-change.mjs does not create spec.md despite harness-contract.md and workflow-guide.md both documenting it as one of the 4 required artifacts — a real, currently-shipping gap, independent of Track B.
